numerical_failure.observed_behavior: The smoothed measurement disturbance from the univariate smoother is returned for C_t^{-1} eps_t rather than eps_t, because the diagonalized transform (H_t = C_t D_t C_t') is not undone; the discrepancy is off by up to 124 on the TestMultivariateGeneralObsCov model (affects FILTER_CONVENTIONAL too via fallback on singular F_t).
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The smoothed measurement disturbance should equal eps_t, i.e. premultiplied by C_t (eps_hat_t = C_t eps_hat_t*); after the fix the discrepancy is 1.2e-09 on the TestMultivariateGeneralObsCov model.
trigger_conditions: Non-diagonal observation covariance H_t (univariate filtering approach diagonalizes it as C_t D_t C_t')
Exact diffuse periods always use the univariate approach
Multivariate filter (e.g. FILTER_CONVENTIONAL) falls back to univariate on a singular forecast error covariance F_t

input_output_examples.expected_output: agreement with conventional smoother to 1.2e-09 after fix (absolute tolerance 1e-7 used in tests)

oracle_clues: test_univariate.py comparisons against conventional smoother with absolute tolerance 1e-7
y_t = Z_t alpha-hat_t + eps-hat_t identity check
Covariance smoothing not fixed: univariate recursions only give diagonal of Var(C_t^{-1} eps_t); now warns with OutputWarning

category_specific_evidence: Simulation smoother comparisons were passing variates to simulation_smoother() rather than to simulate(), so they compared arrays of zeros; they now use fixed variates and the same absolute tolerance as neighbouring comparisons.
PR#9979 adds a parametrized check that y_t = Z_t alpha-hat_t + eps-hat_t holds, pinning output without a reference implementation and covering the diffuse path.

Kalman smoother diagonalization fix: when model._diagonal_obs_cov == 0 and k_endog > 1, the smoothed measurement disturbance is back-transformed via trmv with the Cholesky transform (eps-hat_t = C_t eps-hat_t*).
Test suite counts reported in PR body: 19706 passed / 361 skipped before, 19726 passed / 350 skipped after, with 5 pre-existing unrelated failures.
Reviewer re-ran test_univariate.py and test_multivariate_switch_univariate.py: 428 passed, 4 skipped at head e9bab398a20181b6795acbf3db231e21db8c2267.
reproduction_risks: Passing zero variates makes simulation smoother comparisons trivially equal; reproduction must use nonzero fixed variates (e.g. seeded RandomState normal draws) via simulate().
Diagonalized observation covariance case requires the triangular back-transform; omitting it changes smoothed measurement disturbances.
Five pre-existing failures (test_plot_month, three test_forecast_index_types, TestGenericRLM::test_zero_collinear) are unrelated and should be excluded from comparisons.
